[3:14PM] #Mushin #Oshodi #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic across Mushin and its adjoining routes remains calm and steady, with good movement throughout the area. There is smooth flow from Moshalasi through Alakara Police Station, Idi Oro, all the way down to Olosha. Similarly, traffic along Regina Mundi moving towards Ojuwoye is flowing well.

The corridor from Post Office through AP, Olorunshogo, Challenge, Ilupeju Bypass, and down to Oshodi Underbridge inward Arena is recording good movement. The return journey from Bolade Oshodi, Brown Junction, and onward to Goro and Oshodi Underbridge is also moving efficiently.

Oshodi Oke descending by Terminal 2 remains free, while the route underneath the bridge ascending Oshodi Oke by Terminal 1 is in good condition. The axis covering Olupese, Cappa, and Ilupeju Bypass is experiencing no delays.

Movement from Olorunshogo AP through Ladipo Junction and onward to Ojuwoye is seamless. Similarly, traffic from Ojuwoye connecting Isolo Road, Onilegogoro, Palm Avenue, Oye Roundabout, and towards Daleko Bridge inward LASUTECH is steady. The return stretch from Daleko Bridge heading back through Mushin to Ile Epo Isale is also has good movement.

Traffic from Total Filling Station Mushin towards LUTH Junction, Olosha, Idi Oro, and back to Moshalasi is flowing as expected. Our officers are actively present and managing the flow effectively. No major impediments have been reported in the area.

#FollowLASTMA

[3:42PM] #Egbeda_IyanaIpaja #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic along Goye inward Danco on the Lagos-Abeokuta Expressway is moving smoothly at this time. However, there is some slow-moving traffic observed from Access Bank by Araromi up to Iyana Ipaja Underbridge. The return journey along this same stretch remains fast-moving and unproblematic. 

At Alagba, both the ascending and descending sections of the overhead bridge inward Iyana Ipaja Roundabout are experiencing steady but manageable traffic flow, which remains encouraging.

Traffic from Iyana Ipaja Roundabout through Mosalasi Roundabout and onward to Baruwa Junction is flowing well, with a slight delay noted within the Baruwa Roundabout area. The return journey along the same route back to Iyana Ipaja Roundabout is also moving smoothly.

From Mosalasi Roundabout heading toward Isheri Roundabout via Egbeda Intersection, traffic remains free in both directions, with no significant delays.

No impediments is observed across the areas at present.
#FollowLASTMA
